How rewards work

Points, tiers, holds and exclusions
  • 100 points = $1 in credit. Points can be used on any product in the portal (not taxes, shipping or fees).
  • The minimum redemption is 2,500 points ($25).
  • New points and the launch bonus are usable 7 days after they're earned. Refunded points are usable 48 hours after the refund.
  • Tiers are set by your rolling 3-month average net paid spend: Gold under $7,500 · Platinum $7,500 to $19,999 · Diamond $20,000+. New accounts start Gold in Month 1; the average builds over the first 3 months. Recalculated monthly; you move to the tier your new average qualifies for starting the next month.
  • Same points at every pharmacy. Purchases paid with points don't earn points. Points don't earn points.
  • Redeemed points don't count toward qualifying spend, tier, or the launch bonus.
  • Refunds come back as points (100 points = $1); points earned on the returned order are reversed.
  • Gift cards don't earn points and can't be bought with points. Points have no cash value and are non-transferable.
  • Not available for government-funded purchases (Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, the VA, CHIP, state or local programs, or government-funded employee health plans). If it's unclear whether a payer is government-funded, the purchase is treated as excluded.

Net paid spend = gross purchases - redeemed credits - returns, excluding taxes and shipping.
